συντρέχω.shortDefinition: to run together, flock (to); fig. to run with, join (in)

συντριβή.shortDefinition: a crushing, breaking; fig. a destruction

συντρίβω.shortDefinition: to smash, shatter; fig. to crush, break (down)

σύντριμμα.shortDefinition: a fracture, break; fig. a ruin

συντριμμός.shortDefinition: a smashing, breakup; fig. a ruin, trouble

σύντροφος.shortDefinition: a foster brother, companion from childhood

συντυγχάνω.shortDefinition: to come up to, meet with

συνυποκρίνομαι.shortDefinition: to join in pretending, play the hypocrite with

συνυπουργέω.shortDefinition: to join in helping, assist together

συνωδίνω.shortDefinition: to be in labor together, share birth pains

συνωμοσία.shortDefinition: a conspiracy; lit. a swearing together

συρισμός.shortDefinition: a hissing (in scorn), whistling; fig. a piping (to flocks)

σύρω.shortDefinition: to drag, haul; fig. to trail, sweep away

συσκοτάζω.shortDefinition: to darken completely, grow quite dark

συσπαράσσω.shortDefinition: to convulse violently, throw into convulsions

συσσεισμός.shortDefinition: a rumbling, shaking; fig. a whirlwind, commotion

σύσσωμος.shortDefinition: to be of the same body

σύστασις.shortDefinition: an association, conspiracy; lit. a standing together; fig. a structure

συστέλλω.shortDefinition: to draw together, contract; fig. to shorten, humble, wrap up

σύστημα.shortDefinition: a gathered body, mass; fig. a band, community

συστοιχέω.shortDefinition: to march in line with; fig. to correspond to

σύστρεμμα.shortDefinition: a confederation, band; fig. a conspiracy

συστρέφω.shortDefinition: to twist together, bundle; fig. to conspire, band together

συστροφή.shortDefinition: a swarm, band; fig. a conspiracy, riotous mob

συσφίγγω.shortDefinition: to fasten tightly, gird up; fig. to clench (shut)

σφαιρωτήρ.shortDefinition: a ball ornament, knob; fig. a strap

σφάλλω.shortDefinition: to make slip, cause to fall; fig. to err

σφενδόνη.shortDefinition: a sling; fig. a sling stone

σφραγίζω.shortDefinition: to seal (up); fig. to certify, keep secret

σφραγίς.shortDefinition: a seal, signet; fig. a proof, confirmation

σφυροκοπέω.shortDefinition: to hammer, strike with a hammer

σχίζα.shortDefinition: a shaft, dart; lit. a splinter

σχίζω.shortDefinition: to split, tear (apart); fig. to divide

σχίσμα.shortDefinition: a rip, rent; fig. a division, schism

σχοινίον.shortDefinition: a rough cord, rope; fig. a measuring line, portion

σχοῖνος.shortDefinition: a bulrush, reed; fig. a reed pen, measured path

σχολή.shortDefinition: a vacancy, abandonment; fig. a school

σωματοποιέω.shortDefinition: to restore to health, invigorate; lit. to embody

σωρεύω.shortDefinition: to pile on, heap (upon); fig. to load (down)
